question: Does the sole zero-row-selected exact-lethal Facet-salvage representation preserve current-main at omitted and explicit off, preserve Ash and every mechanistic negative control at on, and isolate its producer, mediator, consumer, one-Ember payoff and expiry under direct A/B/AB controls?
hypothesis: A Duskblade Attack exact-lethal hit can mark only the base intrinsic Facet entitlement otherwise discarded for the dead target. The originating card's existing deferred Facet settlement can aggregate one or more such marks to one Ember request after unchanged living-target settlement, then clear the marks, without RNG, persistent state, acquisition, UI, policy or another PLAY.
claimBoundary: Source, interface, direct A/B/AB, call-cardinality, exact-null and intended-mediator identity only. No support, natural activation, capacity, causal endpoint, policy sensitivity, complementarity, balance, product, acceptance or P9 claim.

scientificBasis.selection: The preregistered zero-row enumeration selected exactly facet-salvage-one-ember under owner comment 5460811702. No other exact-lethal form is eligible and positive overkill remains deferred.
scientificBasis.representation: The research representation adds two dormant booleans only to split producer and consumer for A/B/AB identity. The admissible causal factor remains one binary off/on factor; A-only and B-only are mechanical controls, not product levels.
scientificBasis.minimality: Reuse hit_enemy exact-lethal algebra, pending_chips, play_card's deferred settlement and gain_embers. Add no CombatState or RunState field, event registry member, content field, relic, save field, policy hook, selector, RNG call or player-facing semantic surface.
scientificBasis.noGuessing: Every row is a predeclared source-derived positive or negative control. No support, frequency or outcome is read to choose a setting, scenario or threshold.

terminalHitPrecision.enabled: For a Duskblade authored Attack only, mark each exact-lethal canonical hit's otherwise-lost base intrinsic Facet entitlement; at the same card's deferred Facet settlement, request one Ember at most once if combat continues, after unchanged living-target settlement, then clear.
terminalHitPrecision.forbiddenEffects: No authored chip, Beacon, explicit chip effect, positive overkill, non-Attack damage, direct hit outside PLAY, poison, Ash, finale handoff, later PLAY, another target, save field, run field, RNG, policy or acquisition effect.

producerControl.intendedMediator: The originating card's existing pending_chips record gains exactLethalIntrinsic=true only for a Dusk exact-lethal authored Attack hit.

consumerControl.intendedMediator: If and only if one or more eligible producer marks exist and combat continues, the same card's deferred settlement requests one Ember once and expires the aggregate.

scorelinePayoff.fixed: Separate immutable causal factor; absent and not pooled with Afterimage or terminal-hit precision.

afterimagePayoff.fixed: Separate immutable causal factor; absent and not pooled with Scoreline or terminal-hit precision.

acquisitionPriority.fixed: No relic, card or acquisition surface is introduced or varied.

wardSetupPriority.fixed: No Ward or setup policy is introduced or varied.

design.type: One-factor direct identity preflight with internal A/B/AB mechanical controls; not a factorial and not an endpoint experiment.

matrix.currentMainBaseline: Fourteen frozen direct scenarios on unmodified c4130163, one observation each.
matrix.candidateOmitted: The same fourteen identities before any configuration call, proving static default null.
matrix.candidateExplicitOff: The same fourteen identities with producer=false and consumer=false.
matrix.candidateAB: The same fourteen identities with producer=true and consumer=true.
matrix.componentControls: A-only and B-only on the single Dusk exact-lethal non-final anchor.

design.order: Within the candidate process execute all omitted rows first, then all explicit-off rows, then all AB rows, then A-only and B-only. This makes omitted observe class defaults before any enabled setting and makes every later row explicitly configured.

anchors.exactNull: After removing probe-only factor-availability/configuration labels and row id, current-main, omitted and explicit off must be canonically identical for all fourteen scenarios.
anchors.positive: Dusk exact-lethal authored Attack rows must expose the complete ordered chain and change only the realised Ember delta plus research telemetry.
anchors.negative: Non-lethal, positive-overkill, Ash, direct non-card damage, direct Attack outside PLAY, poison and finale handoff remain exact null at AB.
anchors.component: A-only may create and expire only the per-card mediator; B-only is exact null without that mediator; AB must preserve A's producer and mediator and add only the fixed consumer/payoff.

estimands.baselineIdentity: Zero canonical mismatches for current-main versus omitted and current-main versus explicit off across all fourteen paired identities.
estimands.nullAliasIdentity: Zero canonical mismatches for omitted versus explicit off across all fourteen identities.
estimands.duskAndMechanismNulls: Zero research events and zero canonical mismatches for every AB negative control.
estimands.producerIdentity: A-only emits one exact producer and one intrinsic mediator-set event, then one consumer-disabled expiry, with no Ember or other state/path change.
estimands.consumerIdentity: B-only emits no research event and is exact-null without a mark.
estimands.abChain: For each eligible row, exact ordered producer/mediator pairs, at most one consumer, one requested-one payoff when combat continues, and one expiry; two all-enemy marks still yield one request.
estimands.payoffIsolation: After removing research events and the single realised precision Ember event, and subtracting its realised delta from final Embers, the complete queue, combat state, enemies, run statistics, pending state, action result and RNG equal explicit off.
estimands.rngIdentity: Exact before/after RNG equality within every paired contrast; the factor itself consumes no RNG.
estimands.notEstimated: Support, frequency, natural activation, capacity, policy choice, outcome, interaction with any closed package, balance, product value, acceptance and protected confirmation.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: terminalHitPrecision by exactness: only zero-overkill lethal Attack hits create the otherwise-lost intrinsic Facet mark.
terminalHitPrecision by aspect: the mediator is meaningful only for Duskblade because current apply_chips is Dusk-only; Ash is an exact-null anchor.
terminalHitPrecision by card call topology: multiple exact-lethal hits on one card create multiple marks but the same card's consumer aggregates them to one fixed request.
terminalHitPrecision by Ember cap: the request remains one while realised payoff may be zero under the unchanged Ember-cap law.

aliasStructure.nullAliases: Current-main absence, candidate class-default omission and explicit false/false are required exact aliases.
aliasStructure.closedFamilySeparation: Generic any-kill and Reaper's Bell consume in _on_enemy_death; this mediator is the dead target's otherwise-lost base intrinsic Facet entitlement and its consumer is the same card's later deferred settlement. Immediate-next-PLAY, target transfer, Shatter tempo, draw, duplicate, Scoreline and Afterimage remain closed and absent.
aliasStructure.deferredFamilySeparation: Positive overkill is a negative control here and remains the next serial family only if exact lethal closes.
aliasStructure.componentAlias: B without A is exact null. A without B exposes only the ephemeral mediator and expiry. These controls identify the AB chain but are not additional causal-factor levels.

directScenarios.purpose: Non-lethal authored Attack: living-target intrinsic Facet settlement remains unchanged and no precision mark exists.
Positive overkill is excluded and remains deferred.
Primary exact-lethal non-final positive and sole A/B/AB component anchor.
Exact lethal ending combat marks then expires without consumer or payoff.
Exact-lethal non-Attack direct damage outside PLAY is null.
Even an Attack-labelled direct hit is null without the originating card's pending settlement.
One exact terminal hit in a two-hit card creates one mark and one request.
Two exact-lethal targets aggregate order-independently to one request after unchanged living-target CHIP and SHATTER settlement.
Authored chip and Beacon do not increase the dead-target salvage request.
The fixed one-Ember request is observed with realised zero under the unchanged cap law.
Exactness uses canonical post-block HP loss rather than printed damage.
Finale handoff is exact null even when printed damage reaches the threshold.
